name: Honeywell Technologies
outlook:
What Honeywell Technologies says to expect

  • Full year 2026: sales, margin and earningsThe company now expects full-year sales of $20.0 billion to $20.1 billion with organic 1 sales growth of 4% to 5%, and 5% to 6% organic 1 growth in the fourth quarter; segment margin 1 of approximately 20.5%, at the upper end of its previous guidance range, representing segment margin 1 expansion of approximately 290 basis points; and adjusted earnings per share 1 of $8.40 to $8.45, up 30% to 31%, representing a $0.23 increase from the midpoint of its previous guidance range.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 22, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
